events.name: Japan GDP (Q-o-Q)
events.description: Preliminary Q3 change in Japan's economic output; key input for the BoJ's next rate-hike decision.

events.name: China Industrial Production (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Annual growth in Chinese factory, mining and utility output; a core gauge of China's economic momentum.

events.name: US Retail Sales (M-o-M)
events.description: Monthly change in US retail spending; a key read on consumer demand, which drives most of GDP.

events.name: UK Unemployment Rate
events.description: Share of the UK labour force out of work; shapes BoE views on wage pressure and rates.

events.name: UK CPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Annual change in UK consumer prices; the headline inflation gauge guiding Bank of England policy decisions.

events.name: Eurozone CPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Final October reading of euro-area consumer inflation; confirms price pressure facing the ECB at 4%.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Weekly count of new US unemployment benefit filings; a timely, high-frequency signal of labour market health.

events.name: US Philadelphia Fed Manufacturing Index
events.description: Survey of factory conditions in the Philadelphia Fed district; an early indicator of US manufacturing trends.

events.name: China Loan Prime Rate (1Y)
events.description: PBoC-guided benchmark lending rate for Chinese borrowers; signals the stance of Beijing's monetary policy support.

events.name: Japan CPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Annual change in Japan's nationwide consumer prices; a key test of whether inflation justifies further BoJ hikes.
